description: A wrong fact corrected in conversation (Köln, then Düsseldorf), then the current value and what had been stored before. Limit: the correction supersedes the wrong value and recall never supplies a superseded memory. Failure means: the current probe failing is an update defect, the earlier probe failing is the known absence of history recall. Maintenance: meaningful both ways; with maintenance on the superseded record is expected to be deleted (the earlier-value probe fails for that reason), with --no-maintenance it shows whether retrieval could answer at all.

turns.user: Das war falsch. Ich arbeite in Düsseldorf.

probes.question: Was hattest du vorher darüber gespeichert, wo ich arbeite?
